explanation: Compared against erdosproblems.com/841: BPZ24 proved that for at least x^{1−o(1)} many n ≤ x, t_n ≤ exp(O(√(log n log log n))). The statement gives ∃ K with log #{n ≤ x : t_n ≤ exp(K√(log n · log log n))}/log x → 1. Since the count is ≤ x, this is exactly 'count = x^{1−o(1)}'. Faithful.
